title: Budget ₹30,000 routes to Regional Manager only
scenario: Submit a valid ₹30,000 request
expected: Chain = Regional Manager (1 level)
actual: Rule 'Tier 1 - Below ₹50,000' -> Regional Manager (1 level)

title: Budget ₹1,50,000 routes to Regional Manager + Marketing Manager
scenario: Submit a valid ₹1,50,000 request
expected: Chain = Regional Manager > Marketing Manager
actual: Tier 2 - ₹50,000 to ₹2,00,000 -> Regional Manager > Marketing Manager

title: Budget ₹3,00,000 routes to all four approvers
scenario: Submit a valid ₹3,00,000 request
expected: Chain = Regional Manager > Marketing Manager > Marketing Head > Business Head
actual: Tier 3 - Above ₹2,00,000 -> Regional Manager > Marketing Manager > Marketing Head > Business Head

title: Rule boundaries are exact
expected: 1 / 2 / 2 / 4 approval levels
actual: Levels: 1 / 2 / 2 / 4

title: Missing campaign objective fails validation
scenario: Submit a request with no Objective
expected: Status = Validation Failed; error names the Objective field; requester is notified; no approver is notified
actual: Validation Failed; errors: Marketing objective is required; notification: Validation Failed to requester

title: Invalid budget values are rejected
scenario: Submit budgets of -5, 'abc', 0 and ₹60,00,000
expected: Each returns Validation Failed with a Proposed_Budget message
actual: -5: Budget must be greater than zero | 'abc': Budget must be a number | 0: Budget must be greater than zero | 6000000: Budget exceeds the ₹5,000,000 single-request ceiling; split or escalate

title: Invalid dates are rejected
scenario: Submit end-before-start, start in the past, and a 200-day campaign
expected: Date errors on Start_Date / End_Date for each
actual: end<start: End date cannot be before the start date | past start: Start date cannot be in the past | 200 days: Campaign duration cannot exceed 120 days

title: Expected conversions cannot exceed expected leads
scenario: Submit 100 leads with 150 conversions
expected: Validation Failed on Expected_Conversions
actual: Expected conversions cannot exceed expected leads

title: Duplicate request is blocked
scenario: Submit the same name/region/start date twice
expected: Second submission raises DuplicateRequest, no new campaign is created, attempt is audited
actual: Blocked: Duplicate request: you already raised 'Test Campaign 9-1' starting 2026-10-07 as MKT-2026-... (rows unchanged at 23, audited)

title: Campaign IDs are unique and sequential
scenario: Create three campaigns
expected: IDs follow MKT-<year>-NNN and increase by one

title: Executive cannot approve their own campaign
scenario: Aman Sharma (executive) tries to approve the campaign he raised
expected: AccessDenied; campaign remains Pending Approval; attempt is written to the audit trail
actual: Access denied: you cannot approve a campaign you requested (segregation of duties) | status still Pending Approval | audit: Unauthorized Approval Attempt

title: Segregation of duties: an approver cannot approve a request attributed to them
scenario: Requester identity on a request is set to the Regional Manager (simulating a manager-raised request) and that manager tries to approve
expected: AccessDenied (segregation of duties)
actual: Access denied: you cannot approve a campaign you requested (segregation of duties)

title: Approval out of sequence is refused
scenario: Marketing Manager tries to approve before the Regional Manager
expected: OutOfSequence; no approval recorded
actual: Out of sequence: this campaign is still waiting for the Regional Manager (level 1) before your Marketing Manager approval (level 2) can be given | approval_log rows: 0

title: Regional Manager of another region is refused
scenario: Mumbai's Vikram Desai tries to approve a Delhi NCR campaign
expected: AccessDenied (outside region)
actual: Access denied: you are the Regional Manager for Mumbai, this campaign belongs to Delhi NCR

title: Dispatch before approval is blocked
scenario: Execution Team tries to dispatch a Pending Approval campaign
expected: GovernanceViolation; Execution_Status stays 'Not Ready'; blocked attempt audited
actual: Dispatch blocked: campaign is 'Pending Approval' (PENDING APPROVAL - EXECUTION BLOCKED). Open items: Regional Manager Ap... | Execution_Status = Not Ready

title: Database refuses 'Ready for Execution' without full approval
scenario: Raw SQL: set Execution_Status='Ready for Execution' on a pending campaign
expected: SQLite trigger aborts the update (rule enforced below the application)
actual: GOVERNANCE VIOLATION: Execution_Status cannot be Ready for Execution/Executed unless Approval_Status is Fully Approved

title: Database refuses 'Fully Approved' without every required approval
scenario: Raw SQL: set Approval_Status='Fully Approved' with 0 approvals logged
expected: SQLite trigger aborts the update
actual: GOVERNANCE VIOLATION: Fully Approved requires every required approval level to be logged for the current revision

title: Rejected campaign cannot execute and requester is notified
scenario: Regional Manager rejects (with and without a reason), then execution is attempted
expected: Reason is mandatory; status Rejected; dispatch blocked; requester receives a 'Rejected' e-mail
actual: Status Rejected, reason stored: 'Budget duplicates the running Instagram campaign', dispatch blocked, e-mail to Aman Sharma

title: Send back for revision, edit, resubmit restarts the chain
scenario: MM sends back at level 2; requester edits and resubmits
expected: Rework Required -> Pending Approval, Revision 2, approvals restart at Regional Manager; old approvals do not count
actual: Status Pending Approval, revision 2, current approver Rahul Mehta (Regional Manager); level-1 control shows 'pending'

title: Campaign cannot be modified while pending or after approval
scenario: Requester edits a pending campaign and an approved campaign; raw SQL edits budget of a pending campaign
expected: App refuses with 'locked'; DB trigger refuses the raw edit; edit attempts audited
actual: App: Campaign is 'Fully Approved' and locked for editing. Approved or in-approval req... | DB: GOVERNANCE VIOLATION: campaign details are locked while pending approval or after approval

title: Approval log and audit trail are append-only
scenario: Raw SQL UPDATE and DELETE against APPROVAL_LOG and AUDIT_TRAIL
expected: All four statements are aborted by triggers
actual: 4/4 blocked (APPROVAL_LOG is append-only)

title: Two-level happy path to Ready for Execution
scenario: ₹1,50,000: Rahul Mehta then Priya Kapoor approve
expected: Fully Approved, governance FULLY COMPLIANT, Ready for Execution, execution team e-mail contains all required fields
actual: Fully Approved / Ready for Execution / FULLY COMPLIANT; dispatch e-mail has ID, name, region, budget, dates, objective, status, instructions

title: Four-level path needs all four approvals
scenario: ₹3,00,000: approve in order; check state after each level
expected: Pending after levels 1-3; Fully Approved only after Business Head; 4 approvals logged
actual: Pending Approval -> Pending Approval -> Pending Approval -> Fully Approved; 4 approvals logged

title: Only executives of their own region can raise requests
scenario: Regional Manager creates a request; Delhi executive creates a Mumbai request
expected: Both are AccessDenied
actual: Only Regional Marketing Executives can raise campaign requests | You can only raise requests for your own region (Delhi NCR)

title: Execution requires dispatch; execution opens performance tracking
scenario: Mark executed before and after dispatch
expected: Blocked before approval; allowed after; performance row created
actual: Blocked while pending; after approval -> Executed; performance row created (Budget 30,000)

title: Missing lead data is handled
scenario: Update performance with no leads; add a lead to a non-executed campaign
expected: Warning + blank CPL/ROAS (no crash); lead on non-executed campaign refused
actual: Warning: 'No lead data captured yet for this campaign - CPL, conversion rate, RO...'; CPL = None; lead on non-executed campaign refused

title: KPI formulas: CPL, conversion rate, ROAS, ROI
scenario: Check MKT-2026-001 (spec example: 850 leads, 95 conversions, ₹7,20,000 revenue)
expected: CPL = spend/leads, Conv. rate = conversions/leads, ROAS = revenue/spend, ROI = (revenue-spend)/spend
actual: Spend ₹108,500: CPL ₹127.65, conversion 11.18%, ROAS 6.64x, ROI 563.6%

title: Lead roll-up reconciles with LEAD_DATA
scenario: Compare CAMPAIGN_PERFORMANCE totals with a recount of LEAD_DATA for every executed campaign
expected: Leads, qualified, conversions and revenue match exactly for all campaigns
actual: 9 campaigns reconcile; 0 lead rows

title: Dashboard filters and role scoping
scenario: Compare Delhi NCR filter to its raw count; executive sees only own campaigns; regional manager sees own region
expected: Counts equal; executive and RM scopes enforced
actual: Delhi NCR filter = 5 (raw 5); Aman sees 2; RM scope = Delhi only; channel 'Instagram' matches 13

title: Approval rules are table-driven, not hard-coded
scenario: Business Head changes Tier 1 to require RM + MM; a ₹30,000 request is submitted
expected: New request routes to RM > MM; an invalid rule set (gap) is rejected
actual: ₹30,000 now routes Regional Manager > Marketing Manager; invalid edit rejected: Gap or overlap between 'Tier 1 - Below ₹50,000' (up to ₹40,000) and 'Tier 2 - ₹50,000 to ₹2,00,000' (from ₹50,000)

title: Process metrics: reduction formula
scenario: Compute (Before - After) / Before x 100 from measured timestamps
expected: Matches manual calculation; measured average for standard requests < 25 min
actual: Before 120 min -> after 21.5 min (n=8) = 82.1% reduction; at the 25-min ceiling = 79.2%

title: Audit trail covers the whole lifecycle
scenario: Run a campaign from creation to performance; list audit events
expected: Created, Validation Completed, Approval Requested, Approval Granted, Campaign Dispatched, Campaign Executed, Performance Updated all present with user, timestamp and status transition
actual: 9 events: Campaign Created, Validation Completed, Approval Requested, Approval Granted, Governance Check, Campaign Fully Approved, Campaign Dispatched, Campaign Executed, Performance Updated

title: Scripted Diwali demo runs end to end
scenario: Run the 15-step Diwali Smart Savings scenario (₹1,80,000, Delhi NCR)
expected: Campaign created, routed RM > MM, fully approved, Ready for Execution, executed with leads; dashboard KPIs increase
actual: MKT-2026-023: 12 steps in 0.01s; budget ₹180,000, route Regional Manager > Marketing Manager; campaigns 22->23, leads 0->285

title: Every executed/dispatched campaign in the data set is governance-compliant
scenario: Run check_governance on all Ready/Executed campaigns
expected: 100% FULLY COMPLIANT
actual: 11/11 compliant (100%)

title: HTTP layer enforces roles
scenario: Unauthenticated call; executive POSTs /approve; executive GETs the audit export; manager approves via API
actual: 401, 403 (Access denied: you cannot approve a campaign you r...), 403, 200; wrong password -> 401
